items.question: What is Client Data under the MSA?
items.answer: Client Data under the MSA is defined as all data supplied by or on behalf of Client and processed by Provider under this Agreement [1].

evidence.quote: Client Data" means all data supplied by or on behalf of Client and processed by Provider under this Agreement

items.question: How much notice of non-renewal must be given under the MSA?
items.answer: The documents indicate that the notice period for non-renewal under the MSA is ninety (90) days. This is stated in the term and renewal clause, which specifies that written notice of non-renewal must be given at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term [1].

evidence.quote: written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term

items.question: How often does Harrowgate invoice, and is it in advance or in arrears?
items.answer:
Harrowgate invoices monthly in advance, according to the Harrowgate MSA. The document states: "Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date" [1].

The documents do not specify whether invoicing is in advance or in arrears beyond this statement.

evidence.quote: Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date

items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer: Under the Northbridge NDA, information is considered Confidential Information if it is disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, and is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

evidence.quote: Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential

items.question: When is the warehouse rent suspended?
items.answer: The warehouse rent is suspended if the Premises are unfit for use for more than thirty (30) consecutive days because of an event beyond the parties' control. In such a case, the rent shall be suspended until the Premises are fit for use again [1].

evidence.quote: If the Premises are unfit for use for more than thirty (30) consecutive days because of such an event, the rent shall be suspended until the Premises are fit for use again.

items.question: When is the Kestrel storage fee invoiced?
items.answer: The Kestrel storage fee is invoiced on the first business day of each month. This is stated in the amended clause 3.1 of the Storage Services Agreement, which was modified by Amendment No. 1 [1]. The original clause 3.1 also specified that the fee was invoiced on the first business day of each month [2].

evidence.quote: Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.
